ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java import java!com::mulesoft::tool::network::NetworkUtils var op = payload.operation default "" var headers = (payload.headers default []) as Array<String> var insecure = (payload.insecure default false) as Boolean var targetMethod = upper(payload.targetMethod default "GET") var operations = ["ping", "traceroute", "socket", "dns", "curl", "certest", "ciphertest"] fun blank(value) = isEmpty((value default "") as String) var errorMessage = if (blank(op)) "Missing operation" else if (!(operations contains op)) "Unsupported operation: " ++ op else if ((["ping", "traceroute", "socket", "dns", "certest", "ciphertest"] contains op) and blank(payload.host)) "Missing host" else if ((["socket", "certest", "ciphertest"] contains op) and blank(payload.port)) "Missing port" else if (op == "curl" and blank(payload.url)) "Missing url" else if (op == "curl" and !(["GET", "POST"] contains targetMethod)) "Unsupported targetMethod: " ++ targetMethod else null --- if (errorMessage != null) errorMessage else op match { case "ping" -> NetworkUtils::ping(payload.host) case "traceroute" -> NetworkUtils::traceRoute(payload.host) case "socket" -> NetworkUtils::testConnect(payload.host, payload.port) case "dns" -> NetworkUtils::resolveIPs(payload.host, payload.dnsServer default "") case "certest" -> NetworkUtils::certest(payload.host, payload.port) case "ciphertest" -> NetworkUtils::cipherTest(payload.host, payload.port) case "curl" -> if (targetMethod == "POST") NetworkUtils::curl(payload.url, headers, insecure, payload.body default "") else NetworkUtils::curl(payload.url, headers, insecure) else -> errorMessage }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var op = payload.operation default "" var targetMethod = upper(payload.targetMethod default "GET") var operations = ["ping", "traceroute", "socket", "dns", "curl", "certest", "ciphertest"] fun blank(value) = isEmpty((value default "") as String) var hasError = blank(op) or !(operations contains op) or ((["ping", "traceroute", "socket", "dns", "certest", "ciphertest"] contains op) and blank(payload.host)) or ((["socket", "certest", "ciphertest"] contains op) and blank(payload.port)) or (op == "curl" and blank(payload.url)) or (op == "curl" and !(["GET", "POST"] contains targetMethod)) --- if (hasError) 400 else 200
